FT1536.S05.ProgramLaw016.map_product {A B C D : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype C] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq C]
  [DecidableEq D] (p : Law A) (q : Law B) (f : A → C) (g : B → D) :
  ((Divergence.joint p fun x => q).map fun z => (f z.1, g z.2)) = Divergence.joint (p.map f) fun x => q.map g
FT1536.S05.ProgramLaw016.pair_law (t : Tables) :
  pairLaw t = fallbackLaw (trialLaw (pairTrial t)) 80 (Law.pure zeroBlock)
FT1536.S05.ProgramLaw016.vector_law (t : Tables) : vectorLaw t = vectorPair (pairLaw t)
FT1536.S05.ProgramLaw016.norm_trial_law (t : Tables) :
  trialLaw (normTrial t) = RejectionDomination016.reject (vectorPair (pairLaw t)) good
FT1536.S05.ProgramLaw016.selected_law (t : Tables) :
  selectedLaw t = fallbackLaw (RejectionDomination016.reject (vectorPair (pairLaw t)) good) 196 cubeLaw

  (mass : SamplerMassCondition014.MassCondition h) (m : Bytes) (r : Nonce) :
  Divergence.AC (samplerLaw actualSampler h initial m r) (SigmaMath.freshHonest h) ∧
    Divergence.second (samplerLaw actualSampler h initial m r) (SigmaMath.freshHonest h) ≤ 1 + 1 / 2 ^ 47

  (mass : ∀ (h : Rq), domain h → SamplerMassCondition014.MassCondition h) (st : Rq → State) (m : Rq → Bytes)
  (r : Rq → Nonce) :
